 UTH Festival's Omar El Aawar on What Young People Actually Want 
 Everyone seems to have an opinion on what an entire generation thinks, but Omar El Aawar would rather try to speak for himself.
 Farah Desouky
 Nov 17, 2026 
 “Gen Z wants this, the youth demands that.” Everyone seems to have an opinion on what an entire generation thinks, but Omar El Aawar would rather try to speak for himself, and perhaps a few others along the way. Ahead of its third edition, we sit down with the founder of UTH Festival to talk about building a space for young people with little funding, no prior experience and ambitions that perhaps outgrew the resources at hand. We get into why he has grown to hate the word ‘summit’, what drove him to start UTH in the first place, and what young people actually want, beyond what everyone assumes they do.
 UTH Festival returns on November 20th and 21st at the Grand Egyptian Museum. Tickets are available at worldneedsuth.com.
